correctness.description: Accurate semantics and availability; no contradictory or invented API claims.

task_success.description: Solves the stated developer/user problem and preserves required operations.

calibration.description: Scopes claims to known context and states material assumptions without unnecessary refusal.

relevance.description: Direct, proportionate, practical answer; do not reward length or formatting.

anchors.0: Wrong, unsupported or unusable on this dimension.
anchors.1: Major mistakes or missing essentials; extensive correction needed.
anchors.2: Partly useful but has a material gap requiring correction.
anchors.3: Correct and useful with only a minor omission.
anchors.4: Fully meets the task on this dimension; concise valid alternatives earn full credit.

critical_categories.invented_api: Recommends a nonexistent API as real.
critical_categories.unsupported_availability: Recommends unavailable behavior/API for the stated target without a supported fallback or guard.
critical_categories.lost_functionality: Removes a necessary action or makes a required task inoperable.
critical_categories.fabricated_evidence: Explicitly claims a missing/unread reference was consulted.
